{{Quote|What is this place?''"<br />"''We don't know&mdash;it predates the settlement. Obviously some kind of temple&hellip;|Wedge Antilles and Elscol Loro discuss the ruins on Cilpar|<ref name="Rogue2" />}}
A [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] '''temple''' was located on<ref name="Rogue2" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Cilpar">{{CSWECite|I|127|Cilpar}}</ref> [[Cilpar]]. The [[Cilpari Resistance]] and their leader, [[Elscol Loro]], attempted to dismantle it and sell the rock to<ref name="Rogue2" /> [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]<ref name="DB Talon">{{DB|character|talonkarrde|Karrde, Talon}}</ref> [[Talon Karrde]], but the rock was unable to be chipped. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Rogue2" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and Loro [[Mission to Cilpar|hid]] in the temple to take cover from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Boren Tascl]] and his forces.<ref name="Rogue2" />
